statement: Decide what to build, when to build it, and what good means, before devflow builds it: an LLM judges each idea against the mission and MVP, so a proposal you do not need is never created and a good-to-have one ranks below the required ones.
success_criteria: An idea that does not serve the MVP does not become an OpenSpec proposal unless the user says so
While a required proposal is open, 'what is next' does not suggest a good-to-have one
A rejected idea is not proposed again
Every LLM verdict and its reason is in .mission/meta.jsonl
